concepts.label: Indexer node operational state
concepts.note: enum candidate: Active | Warmup | Paused - describes the operating mode of the Indexer process on a node (memory-pressure driven), distinct from the promoted per-index lifecycle enum at https://docs.couchbase.com/ld/concepts/index-state (scheduled for creation | deferred | building | pending | online | offline | abridged)

concepts.label: Couchbase Server 7.0.2
concepts.note: specific patch version; registry only has server-6.5 and server-7.0 (minor versions)

relations.subject: index:memory-optimized-storage
relations.evidence: Memory-optimized index-storage is supported by the _Nitro_ storage engine, and is only available in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition.

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition, standard index-storage is supported by the _Plasma_ storage engine. In this case, compaction is handled automatically.

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: In Couchbase Server Community Edition, standard index-storage is supported by the _ForestDB_ storage engine. In this case, each index saved with the _standard_ option has two write modes

relations.subject: index:standard-storage
relations.evidence: In version 7.0.2 and after, standard index storage supports indexes for both Couchbase buckets _and_ Ephemeral buckets. This applies both to Enterprise and to Community Edition.

relations.subject: index:memory-optimized-storage
relations.evidence: If indexer RAM usage then goes above 95% of the Index Service memory-quota, the indexer goes into the Paused mode on that node; and although the indexes remain in `Active` state, traffic is routed away from the node.
